result_scope: For the three-dimensional projection Y onto v-perp in R^4 and complementary scalar Z=v^T X, independent cap-one fragmented product laws can make E ||rho_{Y|Z}||_infinity^alpha diverge for every alpha in (0,1). In particular the proposed universal 2/3 conditional projection-density moment bound is false. This is not a counterexample to QFORM.

partner_result_applied.application: For v=(1,1,1,1)/2 and E=v-perp, c=3/4 and h=2/3, so G_ij=ch=1/2. Thus for |det Lambda|>=1, the fixed-pair determinant bank obeys sum_{k!=i,j}|det A_{ijk}|>=1/2 even though the conditional 2/3 moment diverges.

unresolved_implication: Replace normalized conditional projection-density moments by a weighted product-preserving nonlinear estimate in which complementary-fiber mass is not divided out before curvature is paid; then stabilize that estimate under arbitrary additional spectral components.
next_step: Develop a weighted outer-pivot/grouped-coordinate or global small-ball inequality that carries the unnormalized original product fiber weight through the rank-three curved payment, and test it on the same m-packet construction and singleton-plus-two-banks families.
